# Desktop app update required

This version of the Television desktop app does not work with this server and needs to be updated to version 1.5.0 or later.

If you use the downloaded Mac app, it updates itself: leave it open until it offers to restart, or [download the latest version for Mac](https://dl.todesktop.com/260923p52umxx/mac/dmg/arm64) and install it.

If you start the app with `tv-desktop`, it was installed with npm and receives no more updates. To move to the downloaded app on an Apple Silicon Mac:

1. [Download Television for Mac](https://dl.todesktop.com/260923p52umxx/mac/dmg/arm64).
2. Open the downloaded disk image and drag Television to Applications.
3. Quit this app, then open Television from Applications. It keeps your saved server connection.

From then on, open Television from Applications, not with `tv-desktop`.
